name: Housing
blurb: Plugins for decorating, placing and managing houses, apartments and your Free Company workshop.

name: Glamour and mods
blurb: Outfit, plate and appearance tools, plus helpers for mod loaders and posing.

name: Market and economy
blurb: Market board price checks, retainer helpers, and tools for selling and crafting for profit.

name: Crafting and gathering
blurb: Crafting macros and solvers, gathering routes and node timers, and fishing helpers.

name: Combat and jobs
blurb: Job gauges, cooldown trackers, timeline and mechanic helpers for raids and trials.

name: UI and HUD
blurb: Replacements and tweaks for the HUD, hotbars, bars, windows, nameplates and menus.

name: Chat and social
blurb: Chat windows and filters, friend lists, translation, and tools for staying in touch.

name: Audio and music
blurb: Orchestrion, bard and music helpers, plus sound and volume controls.

name: Quality of life
blurb: Small helpers that remove friction: tweaks, reminders, trackers and shortcuts.

name: Other
blurb: Everything that does not fit a bigger bucket: odd, useful and one-of-a-kind plugins.
